policy.rule: A Skill performs declared mechanics only. It never selects model identity, preprocessing, YAML values, retry strategy, acceptance thresholds or final outcome.

skills.bootstrap: First x86 probe: python3 $HOBOT_SKILLS_ROOT/config_audit.py inspect --model MODEL --dataset DATASET --output quantization/inspect.json. Its output includes a compact manifest summary; do not inspect helper --help, cat the full manifest, or recreate this inventory with inline code.
skills.boardBatchContract: After one verified archive transfer, run delivery/board_validate.py directly. It verifies the first physical output, executes the labeled batch, runs native performance measurement, samples temperature, and writes delivery/metrics.json. Do not run separate hrt_model_exec help/infer, manual output parsing, or background thermal loops unless its returned diagnostic reports a missing boundary.
skills.finalDecisionContract: decision.json has exactly outcome, modificationTier, retrained, limitations. outcome is success, partial, or failed; modificationTier is A, B, or C; retrained is boolean; limitations is a string array.
preconditions: ONNX model with one static image input
classification validation manifest with id, rgb and label fields
NV12 is the Agent-selected deployed runtime contract
